description: athena-orchestrator gates: the destroy gate, the ops gate with the merge guard, and the docs gate. Each command falls back to asking (or, at a stop, a warning) when the gate cannot run, so a missing Python never waves a command through. In bypass-permissions mode, where a question cannot reach the user, the fallback denies instead.

hooks.command: sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run_hook.sh" destroy_gate.py || { grep -qE '"permission_mode" *: *"bypassPermissions"' && d=deny || d=ask; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"'$d'","permissionDecisionReason":"DESTROY GATE could not run (athena-orchestrator needs Python 3.11+ on PATH, and Git Bash on Windows); review this call by hand. In bypass-permissions mode it is denied, because a question cannot reach the user."}}'; }

sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run_hook.sh" ops_gate.py || { grep -qE '"permission_mode" *: *"bypassPermissions"' && d=deny || d=ask; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"'$d'","permissionDecisionReason":"OPS GATE could not run (athena-orchestrator needs Python 3.11+ on PATH, and Git Bash on Windows); review this call by hand. In bypass-permissions mode it is denied, because a question cannot reach the user."}}'; }

sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run_hook.sh" docs_gate.py || { grep -qE '"permission_mode" *: *"bypassPermissions"' && d=deny || d=ask; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"'$d'","permissionDecisionReason":"DOCS GATE could not run (athena-orchestrator needs Python 3.11+ on PATH, and Git Bash on Windows); review this call by hand. In bypass-permissions mode it is denied, because a question cannot reach the user."}}'; }

sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run_hook.sh" docs_gate.py || echo '{"systemMessage":"DOCS GATE could not run (athena-orchestrator needs Python 3.11+ on PATH); check by hand that docs changed with code."}'
